items.name: conversation/bubble
items.title: Bubble
items.description: Displays conversational content in a message bubble. Supports variants, alignment, grouping, reactions, and collapsible content.

items.name: conversation/marker
items.title: Marker
items.description: Displays an inline status, system note, bordered row, or labeled separator in a conversation.

items.name: conversation/message
items.title: Message
items.description: Displays a message in a conversation, with optional avatar, header, footer, and alignment.

items.name: conversation/message-scroller
items.title: Message Scroller
items.description: A chat scroll container that anchors turns, opens saved transcripts, follows streamed responses, loads history without jumping, and jumps to any message.
